coverage_notes.summary: Twelve targeted searches covered sole/only/last/full-service grocery loss, canceled or suspended emergency food distributions, abrupt pantry or food-bank service closure/reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption. No new U.S. event in the bounded hourly window met the qualifying criteria.
coverage_notes.source_priority: Fresh local news, official/provider notices, and direct source pages were prioritized.
exclusions_observed: Kauaʻi hurricane-recovery reporting was published before the bounded window and described SNAP replacement assistance and services continuing rather than a new qualifying access interruption.
Searches for SNAP/WIC interruptions primarily surfaced older shutdown-era or policy-change coverage, not a new official interruption in the bounded window.
Food-pantry and food-bank results were routine schedules, older closures, preparedness, or non-U.S. items rather than abrupt new service reductions.
No fresh result documented loss of a community's only/sole/last/full-service grocery store, a canceled emergency food distribution, or an immediate official SNAP/WIC interruption.
coverage_notes.production_authority_note: This supplementary recall watch is non-authoritative; production collection remains authoritative.
